summary.intent: Open nine PRs for spec-audit fix branches, organize them under feature-focused Entire trails (grouped by outcome, not per-PR), and clean up the auto-created per-PR trails. Later also diagnose and fix CI failures that hit all nine PRs.
summary.outcome: All nine PRs (#410-#418) were opened and three feature trails (#136-#138) were created and rewritten around the work. The PR branches could not be moved off Entire's auto-created trails (#139, #141-#148) by any supported route. A new CI-break trail and fix branch were created, and a signed commit for the runner.rs test fix was made but not yet pushed or opened as a PR.

repo: All nine PRs fail `Test Suite (ubuntu-latest)`, including the docs-only #410, while main's CI is green, so the failure is systematic and not a flake.
Only one test relies on /usr/bin/env being a standalone binary (a symlink trick with a nested child harness); the runner image differs between the failing run and the last green main run.
Shell tests in the repo had an `rm -rf "$fixture"` bug that wiped the smoke-main worktree; it is guarded in fix/commit-plan-bytes-and-latest-lookup (#414), so merge #414 early.
Three network-bound callisto-cli end-to-end tests fail offline in the agents' sandbox on every branch, so CI is the only check for them.
No pair of the nine branches conflicts (checked with merge-tree), so merge order is free.

code.finding: Test that uses the /usr/bin/env symlink trick was edited to fix the ubuntu CI failure affecting all nine PRs; the fix passed local runner tests, clippy and fmt and was committed signed (exact lines not given).

workflow: Entire auto-creates one trail per PR and the change then belongs to that trail. `entire trail link` rejects a branch already owned by another trail, `trail unlink` returns 409 telling you to reparent, closing the auto-trail does not release the change, and the documented attach-change API route also refuses. No supported CLI or API call reparents a change.

The correct order is: create the trail with `entire trail create --no-branch`, push the branch, `entire trail link <n> --branch <b>`, then `gh pr create`. Whether linking first stops auto-creation is still untested.

Trails should be grouped by feature outcome with problem, outcome, done-when and open decisions, not framed as an audit or mirroring one trail per PR. This was saved to memory as feedback_trails_feature_first.md.

PR creation via gh depended on a PR-bot token minted through age-plugin-se, which needs a Touch ID or keychain prompt (error -25308 'interaction not allowed') and succeeded only on retry once the prompt could be answered.
Each PR open needed its own approval, so they were opened one at a time.

friction: The keychain/Touch ID prompt blocked the first PR attempt, delaying PR creation until a retry succeeded.
Entire auto-created per-PR trails before the feature trails could be linked, because PRs were opened first.
Every route to reparent the nine changes onto the feature trails was blocked, so the user's request to link the branches and close the obsolete trails could not be done.
Trying close-then-link, as the user suggested, still failed; the trail was reopened afterward to restore its original state.
Trail 138's description lost its paragraph breaks when rewritten and had to be fixed.
Nine PRs failed Ubuntu CI because of an environment-sensitive test, and #410 also failed Coverage.
Earlier, the assistant proposed an audit-framed trail and a PR-mirroring layout that the user had already guided against before.
open_items: Reparent the nine PR changes onto trails #136-#138 in the Entire web UI (#136: #142, #143, #144, #146; #137: #141, #145, #148; #138: #139, #147), then close the empty auto-trails.
Push the signed runner.rs fix branch, link it to the CI-break trail, and open its PR before the nine PRs can go green.
Check whether the Coverage job failure on #410 has the same cause as the Ubuntu test failure.
Test whether linking a branch before `gh pr create` prevents Entire from auto-creating a trail.
Decide the PyPI digest rule (REL-PUB-08): whether to require sha256 for uploaded files given private indexes may serve none.
Decide whether `status` should show plan diagnostics that `--strict` cannot escalate.
Restore the wiped worktree smoke-main with `git restore --worktree -- .`.
Delete the audit-fixes worktree after the PRs merge.
Monitor CI to completion on all nine PRs and report results.
